title: Evercraft College Football Power Rankings: Alabama Leads the Field

expectedText: Evercraft College Football Power Rankings: Alabama Leads the Field

derivatives.copy: The Evercraft College Football Power Rankings are live for 2026-10-07. Alabama is No. 1, but the bigger story is the method: completed results, opponent strength, capped margins and visible uncertainty instead of a copied ballot.

We built our college football power ranking as a replayable evidence product rather than a one-off opinion list. Every position traces back to the same completed-game ledger and versioned model, with missing inputs left missing instead of silently guessed.

derivatives.hook: Alabama is No. 1 in Evercraft College Football Power Rankings. Here are the five teams our results model trusts most right now.

production_grade.note: The ranking surface is structured data. Fallen should build the social and motion visual package from the same Top 25 receipt.

rule: Clip may produce approved derivatives, but this handoff alone does not grant social publication authority.
